name: is_rate_valid

params.purpose: rate/PHY-mode value from TX header; bits 2-3 must be clear and bits 4-7 select PHY mode (0xa0/0xc0/0xd0)
rate/MCS index (0-22 or 0x7f special marker) to validate against the selected PHY mode

docstring: Return 1 if the given rate index is valid for the PHY mode encoded in the rate value, else 0.
